traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP are satisfied:
• Core Functionality & Integration: The plugin exports a standard ESLint plugin shape (`rules`, `configs`, and default export) and is integrated into an ESLint v9 flat config via eslint.config.js. CLI integration tests execute the real ESLint CLI with this config and verify expected exit codes for various rules, showing that the plugin registers and runs correctly.
• Quality Standards & NPM Package: The project follows ESLint plugin best practices—a TypeScript codebase compiled to CommonJS in lib/, correct main/types paths in package.json, peerDependency on eslint@^9, and a clear testing and linting setup. The structure matches common eslint-plugin-* packages.
• ESLint v9 Flat Config Compatibility: eslint.config.js is a flat-config array using @eslint/js and @typescript-eslint/parser, conditionally loading the plugin and registering it under the traceability namespace. The CLI tests use this config successfully, confirming compatibility.
• User Experience & Documentation: README.md and user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md provide clear installation steps, minimal and advanced configuration examples (including using traceability.configs.recommended), and validation commands. docs/eslint-plugin-development-guide.md documents the plugin’s internal structure and development workflow. This fulfills the documentation and setup instructions criteria.
• Error Handling: src/index.ts wraps each rule load in a try/catch, logs descriptive errors, and provides a placeholder rule that reports an error at runtime. tests/plugin-setup-error.test.ts and tests/cli-error-handling.test.ts explicitly verify this behavior, satisfying REQ-ERROR-HANDLING and the story’s error handling acceptance criterion (already marked [x] in the story).
• Testing Infrastructure: Jest with ts-jest is configured in jest.config.js, and there are targeted tests for plugin exports, configs, rule registry, error handling, and CLI integration. The npm test command runs Jest in CI mode; the captured outputs show no errors when invoking the suite or the specific tests for this story.
Given this concrete implementation and test coverage, the foundational ESLint plugin structure and its integration for traceability enforcement are in place and behaving as specified. Therefore, the story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md is fully implemented and the assessment status is PASSED.
